'''Pors Tonith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] financier from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] who served as [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A member of the [[Tonith family]], he had originally been a financier before entering military service.

He was the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] force attacking [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]], a vital communications center for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and several others of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

Tonith landed a massive force that quickly overwhelmed the local defenses. The planet remained in Separatist hands until a counterattack by the reinforced [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Nejaa Halcyon]].

Pors Tonith was a great believer in his own military genius and his position as a "favored minion" of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], although some of this may have been hubris on the part of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]. That said, he did seem to have shown a high degree of tactical ability, destroying the planet's garrison by engaging it with an advance force before landing the main body of his troops behind them, catching them between his two contingents and almost completely wiping them out. He showed somewhat less finesse in dealing with a force of [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]], overrunning their position through sheer weight of numbers, though it should be noted that he was directly ordered to do so by Dooku&mdash;an order which he protested against at the time. Although this attack caused his forces to take severe casualties, he was nevertheless able to effectively face the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] counterattack, using a mobile reserve of tank droids and underground bunkers to shield his droids from artillery.

Despite all his careful planning, Pors Tonith's one fatal mistake was having the hostages close to the command center. He was eventually captured by Anakin Skywalker in an assault which, by all rights, should have been suicidal, after the Muun prepared to eliminate his hostages.

==Personality and traits==
Despite his limited military experience prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Pors Tonith proved to be a skilled strategist and tactician. However, he frequently expressed overconfidence about his talents as a commander, regarding himself as a superior battlefield leader to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and underestimating Anakin Skywalker's resolve in their final confrontation.

Tonith also had an affection for [[Dianogan tea/Legends|dianogan tea]], and his fondness for the drink left him with stained [[Color/Legends|purple]] teeth.
